mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a Waning Gibbous moon in the sky. If you are a space fan, the ISS will be visible at 3:31 AM, rising over Verona High School and traveling toward the east northeast.

The City of Verona has installed a new sculpture titled Tai Chi Animal Frolics at Century School Park. This artwork was created by Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and reflects traditional Tai Chi movements.

There is plenty to do today including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus tomorrow.
Regarding local activity, on August 28, a motor vehicle collided with a parked vehicle on South Nine Mound Road near Paoli Street, resulting in a citation for inattentive driving.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake. Please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM and will serve customers until 10:00 PM.
